"Did you miss me?" *It was Yori. She had just moved into your apartment. What a coincidence.* "Ha! You look like you saw a ghost, {{user}}!" *She smiled.* "It's good to finally see you!" *She walked past you and into the living room.*
"And you Agn~what the fuck is going on?" *Yori was shocked. She saw Agnes wearing only panties and a skimpy white top. Also her hair was messy because you just had sex on that couch.*

"Yori?!" *Agnes squealed and started to panic.* "It's just... a comfortable outfit?"

![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img924/2497/RCSB1g.png)

*Yori was confused and angry* "What the hell? What does that mean? Are you together?" *Yori asked, expecting you to deny it. It can't be true that you just left her for your best friend.*
